run_generate_cuda_templates: run the script to generate CUDA template instance files for fattn-tile, fattn-vec, fattn-mma, mmq, and mmq
generate_fattn_tile_instances: generate fattn-tile CUDA instance files for each head_size_kq from HEAD_SIZES_KQ with corresponding head_size_v
generate_fattn_vec_instances: generate fattn-vec CUDA instance files for all type_k and type_v combinations from TYPES_KV
generate_fattn_mma_instances: generate fattn-mma-f16 CUDA instance files for ncols, ncols2, and head_size combinations with filtering rules
generate_mmq_instances: generate mmq CUDA instance files for each quantization type in TYPES_MMQ
generate_mmf_instances: generate mmf CUDA instance files for ncols values from 1 to 16
use_get_short_name: use get_short_name to convert GGML_TYPE_ prefixed quant names to lowercase short names
